MatchHistoryRecord.title: MatchHistoryRecord
MatchHistoryRecord.description: Cloud-synced match history record scoped to a specific user.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this match record.

winnerName.description: Display name of the winning player.

playerWon.description: Whether the authenticated user won this match.

turnsPlayed.description: Total number of turns taken in the match.

capturesMade.description: Number of opponent tokens captured by the player.

aiDifficulty.description: Adaptive AI difficulty level during the match.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Global leaderboard entry tracking player wins, games played, and skill rating.

aiTier.description: Current adaptive Gemini AI tier unlocked.

isGlobal.description: Flag used for aligned global leaderboard list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TournamentLobby.title: TournamentLobby
TournamentLobby.description: Real-time multiplayer tournament lobby with custom rules and invite-only support.

isInviteOnly.description: True if private invite-only lobby, false if public tournament.

customRuleSafeZones.description: Whether star safe zones protect tokens from capture.

customRuleQuickStart.description: Whether each player starts with 1 token already out of the yard.

customRuleCaptureBonus.description: Whether capturing an opponent token grants an extra roll.

playerNames.description: Bounded list (max 4) of participant display names.

currentTurnIndex.description: Index of active player turn (0 to 3).

lastDiceRoll.description: Most recent dice value rolled (0 to 6).

tokenPositions.description: Bounded list of 16 integers representing the board positions of all 4 players' 4 tokens.

lastActionText.description: Summary of the latest move or tournament event.

winnerName.description: Name of the winner when status is completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard rankings indexed by userId.

/tournaments/{tournamentId}.description: Real-time multiplayer tournament rooms and invite-only lobbies.
